title: Zoho Analytics Just Got 6 AI Agents #Shorts
description:
Zoho just turned Zoho Analytics into an agentic analytics platform: Ask Zia now runs six specialised AI agents, a new semantic layer tells the AI what your business terms mean, and a Zoho Analytics MCP server lets Claude and other AI tools query the same trusted data. Prices stay the same.

1. First, define your key terms and metrics once in the semantic layer, like what counts as an active customer.
2. Then just ask Ask Zia in plain English, like: why did our sales drop in the UAE last month?
3. Using Claude? Connect it to the new Zoho Analytics MCP server and ask the same trusted data.
4. Admins can see which agent ran, what data it touched and what it cost.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho Analytics MCP server
- endpoint: Zoho Analytics MCP server (remote and local) + Claude plugin
- docs: Zoho Analytics help

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://itbrief.com.au/story/zoho-analytics-adds-agentic-ai-layer-for-business-data

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.

story.title: Zoho Analytics adds agentic AI layer for business data
story.summary: Zoho Analytics update (28-30 Oct 2026; IT Brief, destinationCRM, Small Business Trends, Diginomica): Ask Zia now uses a central agent that coordinates six specialised agents (data analysis, visualization, data preparation, modeling, coding, actions). New semantic layer = business glossary for AI (terms, synonyms, metrics), ontology layer maps business entities. Custom data agents grounded in your data. Headless BI: Zoho Analytics MCP server (remote and local), a Claude plugin and a CLI. 30 new data connectors (500+ total). Governance: AI observability shows which agents ran, who used them, what data they accessed, AI usage and cost; sandbox to test agents before production. Subscription prices unchanged; some features in preview.
